# fw-crates crate

> Crate intelligence engine over crates.io: the daily database dump, the sparse index and the RustSec advisory-db become a ranked, searchable dataset…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-crates/

Crate intelligence engine over crates.io: the daily database dump, the sparse index and the RustSec advisory-db become a ranked, searchable dataset, per-category awesome lists, load-tested framework benchmarks and a project-skeleton generator. One engine behind `fw crates`, `fw serve`, MCP and the Bun plugin; every output is JSON, MDX or text.
